newsitem.title: UK: UK bookmakers cut odds on Labour win after big bet.
newsitem.headline: UK bookmakers cut odds on Labour win after big bet.

text.p: British bookmakers William Hill said it cut its odds on the Labour opposition winning the next election to 1-3 from 2-5 following what it called the biggest bet of the election campaign.
A man placed 10,000 pounds in a William Hill branch in Manchester, northern England, on Labour at 2-5. The man stands to win 3,100 pounds after deductions.
William Hill said it had lengthened the odds on the ruling Conservatives winning the election, due by May, to 2-1 from 7-4. The Liberal Democrats were quoted at 300-1.
